intro.name: Arkadiusz Sarach.
intro.description: I'm passionate about programming and building solutions that bridge frontend and backend. My strength lies in translating business challenges into elegant, functional code. I'm constantly learning, experimenting with new technologies, and looking for ways to create applications that make a real impact.

about.title: About me
about.text:
My path to programming was unconventional. I studied mining, but spent recent years in logistics and transport — from driver to branch supervisor at a gastro-courier company. Through this work, I learned organization, time management, and decision-making under pressure.

Computers have fascinated me since childhood. As a teenager, I experimented with DOS, but life took a different turn. When I finally returned to programming, I discovered this is what I want to do — translate business problems into code that works.

Since then, I've been regularly expanding my skills in frontend, backend, and developer tools. I value clean code, good practices, and continuous learning of new technologies.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you are interested in discussing potential opportunities, collaborating on exciting projects, or just want to say hello, I would love to hear from you!

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy specifies the rules for storing and accessing information on Users' devices via Cookies in order to provide services electronically by the Administrator.

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.content:
Administrator – means Arkadiusz Sarach, conducting business at email: arkadiusz.sarach@gmail.com

Website – means the website operating at: [website address]

User – means any natural or legal person or organizational unit using the Services.

Cookies – means IT data, in particular small text files, stored and saved on devices through which Users use the Website.

sections.heading: 2. Types of Cookies
sections.content:
The Cookies used by the Administrator are safe for Users' devices. In particular, they do not cause changes in the configuration of Users' end devices or in the software installed on these devices.

The Website uses the following types of Cookies:

a) Essential Cookies – necessary for the proper functioning of the Website, e.g., enabling login to the Website.

b) Performance Cookies – enable analysis of how Users use the Website.

c) Functional Cookies – enable remembering settings selected by Users.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes of using Cookies
sections.content:
The Administrator uses Cookies for the following purposes:

– creating statistics that help understand how Users use the Website,

– remembering User preferences,

– ensuring Website security and performance.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies Management
sections.content:
The User may at any time change the settings of their internet browser to block Cookies or inform about each placement of Cookies on the User's device.

However, please remember that disabling or limiting Cookies may affect the functionality of the Website.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
sections.content: For matters related to the Cookie Policy, please contact the Administrator at email: arkadiusz.sarach@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy specifies the rules for processing personal data of Users using the Website and protects the privacy of persons visiting the Website.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.content: The controller of your personal data is Arkadiusz Sarach, conducting business at email: arkadiusz.sarach@gmail.com

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of data processing
sections.content:
The Administrator processes your personal data for the following purposes:

– communication via the contact form,

– presentation of service portfolio,

– Website visit statistics.

sections.heading: 3. Types of processed data
sections.content:
The Administrator may process the following personal data:

– email address (provided voluntarily in the contact form),

– technical data (IP address, browser type, operating system),

– activity data on the Website.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
sections.content:
The legal basis for processing personal data is:

– Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR – User consent,

– Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – legitimate interest of the Administrator.

sections.heading: 5. Data retention period
sections.content: Users' personal data will be stored for the period necessary to achieve the purposes for which they were collected, but not longer than provided by law.

sections.heading: 6. User Rights
sections.content:
You have the following rights:

– right to access your personal data,

– right to rectify your data,

– right to request data deletion,

– right to restrict processing,

– right to object,

– right to data portability.

To exercise the above rights, please contact the Administrator.

sections.heading: 7. Data transfer outside EEA
sections.content: Your personal data will not be transferred to third countries (outside the European Economic Area).

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.content: For matters related to personal data protection, please contact the Administrator at email: arkadiusz.sarach@gmail.com
